messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Your doctor will use blood tests to check that your dose is right, usually 6 to 8 weeks after any dose change, and then every 6 to 12 months once your dose is stable. Children are tested more often, including 2 and 4 weeks after starting treatment and 2 weeks after any dose change.
Tell your doctor or pharmacist if you take biotin, or a multivitamin, hair, skin, or nail supplement that contains biotin (sometimes listed as vitamin B7). Biotin can interfere with thyroid blood tests and give a falsely high or falsely low result, which could lead to the wrong dose change. Stop biotin and any biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before a thyroid blood test.
If your symptoms and blood tests still suggest an underactive thyroid even though you are on a dose that should be enough, it may be because the medicine is not being absorbed properly, doses are being missed, or another medicine is interfering. Talk to your doctor before your dose is increased.
Triplet: ["levothyroxine", "has monitoring time point", "2 weeks after dose change"]

The relation 'has monitoring time point' in the triplet is defined as 'Blood levels of the subject drug are monitored at the specified time point after treatment initiation or dose adjustment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
B. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
C. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
D. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
E. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
